newsitem.title: USA: Raymond adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Raymond adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Raymond Corp said on Monday it adopted a shareholder rights plan and retained Lehman Brothers to advise it on strategic alternatives.

The rights plan would be triggered if anybody acquires 20 percent or more of the company's outstanding shares. The company said the plan provides protection against "coercive or unfair takeover tactics."
Raymond supplies equipment used in transportation, storage and selection of products in manufacturing and warehousing.
